title: H-D Pan America 1250 Special (Enduro Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Harley-Davidson H-D Pan America 1250 Special (Enduro Spec) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 1250cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
